decision: Bounded mechanical checkpoint supported; semantic acceptance remains open. Exact window handles remove the observed copied-quote rejection on the drive investigation, while changed premises and missing independently requested research still occur.
scope: Independent reading of complete original contexts, raw proposals, admitted selections and current research.py resolver. Assessor had prior case familiarity and prepared the original harness; not blinded or a population accuracy study. No provider calls, production changes, retrieval or browser testing in this review.

mechanical_checkpoint.review: No concrete source-ownership, offset or contract-dispatch defect found by inspection in the v4 window selector. Generated aliases preserve the canonical original source ID; selection resolves against the exact window then adds its original offset; coordinate-based deduplication and canonical ordering preserve distinct sources. Current-source binding remains explicit. Saved v2 and broad v3 have their own admission schemas and query construction.
mechanical_checkpoint.remaining_hold: One agency actual-account proposal lacks a selected current-message source. This is the existing work-ownership contract, not a copied-text error.
limits: Window boundaries are mechanical presentation, not meaning boundaries. The model can still omit a denial, condition, deadline or another investigation.
Selecting a latest-message handle identifies its source; it does not mechanically prove that the words authorise this investigation.
Overlapping nonidentical ranges can still repeat some words in a query. They remain exact; this is an efficiency/ranking concern rather than a demonstrated ownership violation.
Keep window generation and query rendering stable for saved v4 replay. A later changed splitter or representation requires version-aware reconstruction, not regeneration of earlier seals.
This inspection and saved-span check do not replace negative mechanical tests or full authenticated saved-turn replay.

permissible_exploration: Bailment, security/retention, legal protections for original technical material, procedure and contrary positions may be investigated conditionally without the user naming those legal categories. Such searches do not establish an intellectual-property right, lien, legal classification or applicable rule. The consequential problems above concern changed original factual premises or omitted work, not legal vocabulary alone.
remaining_general_invariant: Every current independent legal investigation and its material factual qualifications must survive from the original conversation to the search plan; discovery concepts must not strengthen or broaden their factual premise. Exact-source handles certify where selected words came from, not whether the selection is complete or the legal interpretation is faithful.
completion_boundary: May record the exact-handle and versioned original-account query mechanics as a verified prerequisite once focused negative tests and replay pass. Do not mark decomposition, retrieval relevance, whole-context response review, SEQ.1-4 or browser acceptance complete on these results. No additional routine model call is established by this assessment.
